result.instructions: Two tools for the running desktop. AX reads and operates application windows through accessibility: it lists windows, returns controls as rN refs, acts on them, and waits with until. GUI takes full-desktop screenshots and sends pixel input. Use AX for named controls, values, menus, dialogs, windows, and keys. Use GUI for pixels, canvases, dragging, and controls that AX does not expose; after one targeted AX find misses a visible control, use GUI for it. Send all desktop input (window activation, keys, text, mouse) through these tools, not shell input utilities or scripted accessibility calls: the tools check the target window before input and report what changed, and outside input makes their refs and diffs stale. After GUI input, read AX again before reusing refs.

predicate.description: Poll one AX predicate until true or timeout_ms; false is a result. selector and title check every window of the app, dialogs and popups included; ref reads that element.

negate.description: Wait for it to be false; title negate is true once the app has no such window, or has exited.

stable_ms.description: How long it must stay true; filters flicker.

text.description: text: element text substring; title: substring of any window title of the app.

actions.description: act: ordered actions in one window.

ref.description: rN element; wN for activate/close. Omit for keys/text to the focused window.

title.description: activate/close: unique window-title substring, instead of wN.

app.description: App name, app id, or PID; use once, then window_ref.

cursor.description: find: next_cursor from a truncated result; send with mode find only.

mode.description: apps lists every top-level window (wN, title, app, active); observe returns a tree or diff with rN; find returns matching rN; act runs actions.

observe.description: Returned evidence. act and until: default diff; observe: default tree. none only with act or until.

query.description: find: at least one filter; ANDed, case-insensitive.

root.description: observe: subtree at rN or the focused element.

window_ref.description: observe/find: window to read. act: omit when actions have refs, which name the window; it only sends ref-less keys/text to wN instead of the focused window.

tools.name: AX
tools.title: Accessibility

tools.description: Full-desktop screenshot and pixel input. {"actions":[{"type":"screenshot"}]} alone observes. Any other batch is checked before input and returns one final screenshot. x/y are pixels of the latest full-desktop GUI image, never of an AX window image. type/keypress go to the current focus, so click the field first in the same batch. Batch the actions planned from one screenshot; end the batch after an action that may open, close, or move a window, and plan the rest from the returned image. GUI cannot address windows; AX activates and closes them by title. wait is one second with no observation, at most 20 s per batch. Example: {"actions":[{"type":"click","x":640,"y":412},{"type":"type","text":"hello"},{"type":"keypress","keys":["ENTER"]}]}

inputSchema.description: One screenshot action observes; otherwise run an input batch.

type.description: Capture the final full desktop; this must be the only action.

x.description: X pixel in the exact returned full-desktop image

y.description: Y pixel in the exact returned full-desktop image

type.description: Wait exactly one second without an intermediate observation; do not stack waits.

settle_ms.description: Visual stillness: default 800ms, max 3000ms. Final screenshot stillness, not semantic success and not extra sleep. After wait, usually omit it. At the cap inspect the screenshot or use AX until.

cli.--help:
Computer Use

Usage:
  computer-use [command] [options]

Commands:
  mcp                  Start the stdio MCP server.
  doctor               Print platform runtime requirements.
  call <AX|GUI>         Call one public tool, or run a JSON array of calls.
  help [command]       Show general or command-specific help.
  version              Print the CLI version.

Notes:
  Run in the signed-in desktop session. Native providers use Linux AT-SPI2,
  macOS Accessibility, or Windows UI Automation. Run doctor for requirements.
cli.help call:
Usage:
  computer-use call <AX|GUI> [--args '<json-object>']
  computer-use call --calls '<json-array>'

Only the public AX and GUI tools are accepted.
